en.sosgapStillTrying: Your SOS has not reached your family yet. Assisto keeps trying every 15 seconds — it goes out as soon as the internet is back, even if you leave this screen.

@sosgapStillTrying.description: gap-sos: Emergency SOS offline, the app keeps retrying the same SOS

@sosgapStopTrying.description: gap-sos: stop retrying an unsent SOS (does not close the screen)

en.sosgapOpenFull: Who is on the way · live location · 30 s sound

@sosgapOpenFull.description: gap-sos: Emergency hub, after SOS sent: open the full SOS page (who is going, live location, sound, sent by mistake)

@sosgapSosButtonLine.description: gap-sos: line next to the SOS icon on the red SosButton (the icon already says SOS — never repeat it)
